name: A Tale Under Earth
source:
You descend into a barrow-tomb--only to find it not at all unoccupied. Can you escape with your life?

[From [url=https://thaumaturge-art.itch.io/a-tale-under-earth]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你深入一座古墓，却发现里面并非空无一人。你能活着逃出去吗？

[来源：[url=https://thaumaturge-art.itch.io/a-tale-under-earth]Itch.io[/url]]
